tasks.label: build debug
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path build/CMakeCache.txt)) { cmake --preset windows-vs2022 }; cmake --build --preset debug

tasks.label: build release
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path build/CMakeCache.txt)) { cmake --preset windows-vs2022 }; cmake --build --preset release

tasks.label: clean
tasks.command: cmake --build --preset debug --target clean; cmake --build --preset release --target clean
